integrity: Analytic proof with separate reproducibility script; independent priority assessment and independent scientific audit have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for positive alternating spacings, constant Brownian diffusivity, nearest-site instantaneous Poisson resets, fixed cell length and rate; merger is a limiting configuration. No general irregular-array optimality theorem.
title: Golden-ratio geometry transition for two-spacing nearest-site Brownian resetting
